arithmetic.binary64_input_evidence: Every valid case includes source decimal strings, float.hex(), and exact integer ratio evidence for each numeric input.
arithmetic.binary64_rational_preservation: mp.mpf(float_value) was checked against mp.mpf(numerator)/denominator from float.as_integer_ratio().
arithmetic.comparison_rule: abs(observed-reference) <= absolute_tolerance + relative_tolerance*abs(reference); absolute tolerance is zero, so an expected zero must match exactly and a positive expected Rs cannot be replaced by zero; status/null semantics are compared exactly.
arithmetic.overflow_rule: A finite binary64 output is never substituted when the high-precision expected result exceeds maximum finite binary64; explicit numerical failure is expected.

scope.censoring_rule: Censored analytes retain null event time and a right-censor bound equal to acquisition duration; censored analytes do not form pairs.
scope.fwhm_per_sigma_limitation: 2.3548 is the producer's rounded convention; the exact Gaussian conversion 2*sqrt(2*ln(2)) is approximately 2.354820045 and is not used by this profile.
nonclaims: No physical peak width or plate height is inferred.
No chromatogram, noise, overlap deconvolution, detector response, or hardware is simulated.
No chemical identity or actual retention model assignment is inferred.
No fresh fit or optimizer run is performed and no Bayesian-optimization readiness is claimed.
scope.numeric_inputs: Original decimal strings are converted once to IEEE-754 binary64. The mpmath reference uses the exact rational represented by each binary64 value.
scope.pair_rule: Sort finite eluted centroids by (retention_time_min, analyte_id), then emit only adjacent finite pairs.
scope.per_analyte_rule: Each eluted analyte reports the minimum Rs among incident adjacent finite pairs; if it has no such pair its resolution is unsupported. Censored analytes have status censored and null Rs.
scope.resolution_rule: Rs = delta_t / (2 * (sigma_i + sigma_j)); sigma = fwhm / 2.3548 using the producer's declared binary64 constant.
scope.singleton_rule: A finite singleton has unsupported resolution and null Rs; it is not imputed as zero.
scope.tie_rule: Equal finite centroids yield observed zero pair resolution; ID order makes adjacency deterministic.
